units.source_text: 不能说因为了无记忆，就可以简单认为人是“消失”或“丧失”在过去的日子里。

en.t: One cannot say that simply because there is no memory, a person can be easily regarded as having “disappeared” or been “lost” in the days of the past.

units.source_text: 另外，我不想在这部作品里解释记忆和忘却的意义，也不想接触时间和生命的问题。

en.t: Besides, I do not want to explain the meaning of memory and forgetting in this work, nor do I want to touch on questions of time and life.

units.source_text: 然而，对我来说，它的确是一些线索、一些证据。

en.t: Yet for me, it is indeed a set of clues, a set of evidence.
